## Summary

What changed, and why? Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List commands/checks actually run and their results. If something wasn't tested, say why. Include screenshots for UI changes and before/after measurements for memory changes.

## Risks and limitations

Note permission, process-lifecycle, performance, compatibility, or distribution implications. Omit if not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused; no unrelated files, build products, or secrets are included.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or this is a documentation-only change.
- [ ] User-facing docs and changelog are updated where appropriate.
- [ ] Screenshots, commands, and diagnostics have been checked for private information.
- [ ] Contribution/licensing terms have been agreed with the maintainer where needed.
